# BAD-016 — Email campaigns by syncing opted-in marketing contacts into a Resend Audience

## Brief
From BadTakes TODO.md item 32, the email campaigns half. Consent already exists: private.marketing_contacts is populated at activation, and migration 0023 added a token-based unsubscribe (the unsubscribe Edge Function) with signing up opting in. Nothing sends a campaign yet.

Fix direction: sync opted-in contacts into a Resend Audience. RESEND_API_KEY and LICENSE_FROM_EMAIL are already configured secrets and _shared/email.mjs already talks to Resend, so sending becomes writing a Broadcast in the Resend dashboard with no new vendor.
- A failed sync never fails activation. marketing_contacts.synced_at is how an unsynced row is found and retried.
- An unsubscribe, through Bad Takes' own link or Resend's, has to reach the other side, so the two lists never disagree. Account deletion (0039) removes the contact from the Audience too.
- Segmentation comes from private.events joined to marketing_contacts.

Verification: the server-changes skill, and the Server integration CI check. Deploys run from CI only.
